workflow_runs.display_title: fix: race condition causing exec mode to hang with --image flag

head_commit.message:
Fix race condition in exec mode image handling

When images are submitted in exec mode, two threads compete for events
from the same conversation stream: the background event-forwarding thread
and the main thread waiting for TaskComplete. This causes the main thread
to hang indefinitely when the background thread wins the race.

Fix by reading from the rx channel instead of calling conversation.next_event()
directly, ensuring all events flow through the background thread's channel.

Credit to @AdsQnn for diagnosing this issue in #5773.

Signed-off-by: Jet Sanchez <jetsanchezzz@gmail.com>
